title: Complimentary Alterations Clause: Qualifying Operation, Amount and Purchase Window (Marlowe & Finch Alterations)
content:
**Clause.** Complimentary basic work is waived on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket in a class whose complimentary basic work figure is "yes" and that names the customer's own Marlowe & Finch purchase record.

1. **Qualifying operations.** A plain hem, a cuffed hem, a blind-stitched hem, plain sleeve shortening, taking in a waist, a cuffed suit trouser hem and shortening suit jacket sleeves.
2. **One waiver per ticket.** One complimentary waiver is booked per ticket, for the highest-priced qualifying operation charge of a ticket on which no complimentary waiver stands yet. A ticket that already carries a complimentary waiver has nothing further waived.
3. **Amount, assembled from the complimentary form.** Under the whole-charge form the waiver is the whole operation charge; under the allowance form it is the lesser of the operation charge and the member's sale-work allowance plus the premium-garment addition, and nothing when the sale-work allowance is nothing; under the no-waiver form it is nothing. The waiver is rounded half up to the cent once, on that final figure (a figure at or above the half-cent mark, or within 0.0001 of a cent below it, goes up). On this clause a purchase at regular price takes the whole-charge form and any other price type the no-waiver form, so a regular-price purchase has the whole operation charge waived and any other price type has nothing waived.
4. **Window.** The waiver is owed only when the drop-off date falls within the complimentary window counted from the purchase's completed date: the class's complimentary purchase-window days plus the Finch Circle window extension and the card window extension. On this clause neither extension applies, so the window is the class's purchase-window days. When the drop-off date falls outside the window, nothing is waived.
5. **Counting.** The complimentary window counts calendar days starting the day after the completed date as day 1, and a drop-off on the last day of the window is in time.

## Window, both sides (hypothetical 60-day window)

| Drop-off | Day count | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| 60th day after the completed date | day 60 | owed (last day) |
| 61st day after the completed date | day 61 | nothing |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A regular-price pair of trousers, its purchase record named on the ticket, dropped off on day 20 of the window. Operation charges: plain hem 18.00 USD, taking in a waist 28.00 USD, tapering trouser legs 38.00 USD. Tapering is not a qualifying operation; of the qualifying charges the highest is 28.00 USD, so 28.00 USD is waived. If the ticket already carried a complimentary waiver, nothing further would be waived.
